fun main() {
    val input = System.stdin.readText().trim()

    // parse

                val cur = f[i][j][cnt0]
                val e0 = if (s[i] == t[0]) 1 else 0

                }

        }
    }
    println(ans)

fun gcd(a: Long, b: Long): Long = if (b == 0L) a else gcd(b, a % b)

fun mod(a: BigInteger, n: BigInteger, m: BigInteger): BigInteger {
    if (n == BigInteger.ZERO) return BigInteger.ONE
    if (n % BigInteger.TWO == BigInteger.ZERO) return mod(a * a % m, n / BigInteger.TWO, m)
    return a * mod(a, n - BigInteger.ONE, m) % m
}

fun extendedEuclid(a: Long, b: Long): Pair<Long, Long> {
    if (b == 0L) return Pair(1L, 0L)
    val (x, y) = extendedEuclid(b, a % b)
    return Pair(y, x - (a / b) * y)
}
